caption: The drawing depicts a textile design consisting primarily of shades of blue and white. In the center, there is a large circular emblem with an eagle facing left, holding arrows and an olive branch in its talons, and a shield on its chest. The banner above the eagle contains the phrase "E PLURIBUS UNUM." Encircling the eagle are the words "UNITED STATES OF AMERICA" and the year "1831" is displayed below the eagle. Surrounding the central circle are alternating leaf shapes. The background outside the central emblem features a repeating geometric star and cross pattern in blue and white. A wide border encloses the piece, adorned with large white leafy branches on a dark blue background, with a narrower white border along the outer edge. At the very bottom edge, some handwriting is visible, providing what appears to be a signature, date, and label or annotation.
title: Coverlet (U.S. Seal)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
